title: A customer question about Rate Limits

question.author: member_013
question.body: I need a short answer about rate limits. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current API Reference documentation says: When the limit is hit, the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; clients should implement exponential backoff. Burst allowances are not available. Read-only endpoints (listing, metadata) count the same as writes. API requests are limited to 1000 requests per hour per token. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
